title: Protocol for in vitro analysis of pro-inflammatory and metabolic functions of cultured primary murine astrocytes
protocol: Anesthetize pups.
Euthanize each pup by decapitation.
Gently extract the brain by performing two lateral incisions at the back of the head.
Avoid touching the brains and gently drop them facing up into the petri dishes.
Using magnification system if needed, gently separate the cortices from the rest of the brain.
Add cortices to the 50 mL tubes with HBSS previously prepared.
Repeat steps until done with all the pups.
Spin down cortices in 50 mL tubes at 400 or 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully to avoid moving the cortices.
Add 5 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA, pipette up and down at least 6 times with a 5 or 10 mL pipet to gently disaggregate the tissue.
Incubate for 15 min at 37°C in a cell culture incubator.
Add 10 mL of Complete DMEM/F12 to stop the reaction.
Invert the tube.
Place a 70 micron cell strainer on top of a new 50 mL tube and filter the suspension by gravity flow.
Help the flow through with a syringe plunger if necessary.
Centrifuge the flow-through at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 12–15 mL of Complete DMEM/F12.
Add to the precoated T75 flask.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 85%-95% humidity.
Change media the next day or the latest 48 h later.
Replace media every 2–3 days.
Astrocytes will be confluent and rid of debris by day 7-10.
Shake T75 flask for 30 min at 180–200 rpm at 37°C.
Remove media and add 10 mL of fresh medium.
Shake for 1.5–2 h more at 200 rpm at 37°C.
Check under the microscope for detachment of microglia.
Remove media.
Rinse astrocytes once with HBSS.
Add 4 ml of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA and shake them at 37°C, checking every 2 min until monolayer has detached.
Add 10 mL of complete DMEM/F12 to stop the reaction.
Pipette thoughtfully and transfer to a 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of Complete DMEM/F12.
Count the cells.
Seed the cells according to numbers specified.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 85%-95% humidity for 24 or 48 hours until the cells look flat again.
Mix INTERFERin reagent with the desired siRNAs in Opti-MEM following Table 3 guidelines.
Incubate the mix 10 minutes at room temperature.
Change the media of the astrocytes to fresh new media (Complete DMEM or N1-DMEM) according to volumes specified.
Add the mix of INTERFERin, siRNAs, and Opti-MEM dropwise to the astrocyte’s wells.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Perform downstream analysis after incubation.
Confirm knockdown efficiency by qPCR or western blot from 24 to 96 hours post-transfection.
Transduce astrocytes with lentiviruses if siRNA transfection is unsuccessful.
Electroporate or nucleofect astrocytes if transduction does not yield expected results.
Change the media to fresh media (Complete DMEM or N1-DMEM) with the desired final concentration of required cytokines.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 6–48 hours for gene expression analysis.
Wash cells gently once with HBSS.
Aspirate HBSS.
Lysate cells with Buffer RLT (Qiagen).
Store lysates at −20 or −80°C for later RNA extraction (Qiagen RNeasy kit) or proceed directly with RNA extraction and desired gene expression analysis (RT-qPCR…).
Incubate cells at 37°C with media containing cytokines for 8 to overnight hours.
Wash the cells gently at least twice with HBSS to remove any trace of cytokines.
Replace the washed cells with fresh media without cytokines and incubate at 37°C for 2 days.
Collect the ACM (astrocyte conditioned medium) for downstream studies such as neurotoxicity assays or cytokine production measurements by ELISA.
Aliquot and freeze the collected ACM at -80°C if not using it immediately.
Change astrocyte media to Low Glucose-DMEM before starting the oxygen consumption analysis protocol.
Incubate astrocytes in Low Glucose-DMEM for 24 or 48 hours (starvation step) prior to performing assays.
Stimulate astrocytes, if necessary, while using Low Glucose DMEM.
Hydrate the sensor cartridge in Seahorse XF Calibrant the day before performing the assay.
Start Mito Stress assay with Seahorse XF Cell Mito Stress Test Kit following manufacturer's manual instructions.
Quantify oxygen consumption rate (OCR) real-time after sequential addition of 2 mM Oligomycin, 1 mM FCCP, and 5 mM Rotenone/Antimycin A.
Carefully remove the plate from the Seahorse machine after completing the run.
Aspirate the media from the plate.
Wash cells once with HBSS.
Check under the microscope that the cells are still attached and look healthy.
If cells are not attached or appear severely distressed, refer to troubleshooting documentation.
Aspirate all remaining liquid from the plate.
Freeze the plate immediately at -80°C for at least overnight before proceeding.
Thaw the cell plates at room temperature when ready to proceed.
Quantify the cells using CyQUANT cell proliferation assay kit following the protocol for Cell Number Determination.
Normalize OCR rate to cell number.
